situation: Colleagues sorting out a train to a conference.
topic: What time is the first train from Leeds to London King's Cross on a Sunday?

text: Has anyone checked the first sunday train to kings cross? Want to know if I can get down the day before
Not yet. Which sunday
The 13th. Conference starts the 14th
Can't help, I only ever do weekday trains
I'll look tomorrow on my lunch. The website's rubbish at weekends
Weren't there works on the east coast line on sundays recently. Or was that last month
No idea. Would be useful to know before I book anything
I'll check it. Night
Sunday timetables are a mess on the site. Keeps timing out
Got one for the 13th but it's unclear, might be a bus for part of it. Not sure
A bus with bags would be annoying
Is there an early one or are they all late morning
Don't know yet
Ring the info line, they'll know more than the site
Rang. Hold music for 20 mins then cut off
Typical
Fell asleep on the sofa with the telly on. Is it still Thursday
Found a site that lists the times properly. Will go through it tomorrow
Right, going through it properly now
First train on the 13th gets in around 9 or so. The one before it from Leeds looks like it might be a bus for part of the way. Want to confirm before saying that's definitely it
Richard the works might be real. Site says planned engineering work on the 13th but doesn't say where
Ah. Might have been the Sunday before last then
Thanks. Does the bus thing apply to all of them or just the early one
Dunno. Only the early one looked odd
Sorry, was in a meeting all afternoon. Did anyone get a clear answer
Not really. I'll ring the line tomorrow if the site's still rubbish
I'll book the Saturday night one to be safe. Cheaper than I thought
Good call. Better than a 7am bus
Anyone want the bus times or is it just me obsessing
Send them anyway
